alice: Quick sync — proposing Photon-7B into catalog onramp. Need to nail acceptance gates: perf benchmarks, cost SLA, canary/rollback, and pin TTL. Thoughts? @ben @carla
ben: Quick data point — on p4d we see ~170ms p95 at 512 tokens but cost ~1.6x our baseline. On g4dn it's ~220ms. Need hardware bucket callouts in the spec.
carla: Customers want a pin option (they hate surprise swaps). Suggest default pin TTL 60 days, enterprise opt-in 90 days with migration assistance. We'll own customer-facing comms.
dmitri: Ops constraints: require a 1% canary for 24h with automatic rollback if error rate or latency regress beyond thresholds. Also add a memory/leak smoke test in canary.
alice: Good points. Ben — can we be flexible on cost SLO if quantized variant meets quality thresholds? Also who owns prompt sets for benchmarks?
ben: Yes, allow quantized variants but must pass our eval harness (regression on key metrics <= 2% delta). For cost SLO propose: unit token cost at 95th percentile <= 1.5x baseline. That gives headroom for perf/cost tradeoffs.
carla: Solutions will own prompt suites + a customer sample bucket. We'll add 3 canonical prompt families (completion, instruction, multi-turn) + safety probes. Also want p96 latency in the bench outputs.
dmitri: Canary config suggestion (quick):
```
canary:
  traffic: 0.01
  duration: 24h
  metrics:
    - error_rate < 0.005
    - p95_latency < 200ms
```
alice: Draft acceptance summary to lock in: bench perf (p95 < 200ms @ 512 tokens; p96 reported), cost <= 1.5x baseline at 95th pct, quantized variant allowed if eval pass, canary 1% x 24h with rollback hooks, default pin TTL 60d (enterprise 90d opt-in). Action items: ben -> bench harness & hardware matrix; carla -> prompt suites + comms; dmitri -> rollback runbook & canary automation. Please drop PRs or threads within 48h.
eve: noted and pinged infra ticket for canary infra. :thumbsup:
carla: one more ask — can we add a short migration playbook snippet for customers who opt into 90d pin? I can draft a 1-pager and circulate.
alice: yes please. Thanks everyone — locking these as the onramp acceptance proposal unless objections in 48h.
_meta_note: Single-thread Slack export: messages are short, prefixed by sender names, include bot/ops mentions and a code snippet. No title field per agents.md requirements.
